summary: Verified Emergent-managed Google Sign-in contract + regression on email/phone auth after AuthContext + Welcome screen changes. Backend: POST /api/auth/session returns 401 for invalid/empty session_id and does NOT accept session_token (contract holds). Email register (fresh account) -> tabs, sign-in with same creds -> tabs, Phone OTP send/verify -> tabs, root gate routes correctly (unauth->/welcome, auth->/(tabs)), Google button visible/tappable and navigates the browser to auth.emergentagent.com (confirmed via CORS logs from that origin after tap). No red screen. 10/10 backend pytest passed. One pre-existing UX issue found: tapping the Profile 'Sign out' button clears user state but does NOT redirect to /welcome in the same tick (page still shows the Discover tab under `/`); a full reload correctly lands on /welcome. This is unrelated to the Google-auth patch but should be fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign-out button (testID=logout-btn) invokes logout() + router.replace('/welcome') but user stays on the tabs screen at URL '/'. State (user) is cleared (greeting flips to 'Hi there'), so a reload does land on /welcome, but the immediate navigation fails. Likely because logout() is not awaited before router.replace, and/or root Index useEffect re-fires. Fix: `onPress={async () => { await logout(); router.replace('/welcome'); }}` OR add an auth-guard useEffect inside (tabs)/_layout that redirects when user becomes null.

action_items: Fix Profile Sign-out to reliably navigate to /welcome: await logout() then router.replace('/welcome'), or add a useEffect auth-guard in (tabs)/_layout.tsx to redirect to /welcome when useAuth().user becomes null.
critical_code_review_comments: google_auth.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id from returned user_data (uses projection on the read path; also pops _id on new inserts). Good.
AuthContext.googleLogin uses a handledSessions ref to prevent duplicate exchanges of the same session_id — nice, prevents double-run from the mount useEffect on route changes.
AuthContext web-side effect calls process(window.location.href) on every mount; session_id is cleared from URL via history.replaceState after success. Good.
welcome.handleGoogle uses window.location.href = ... on web (full navigation) — expected for the redirect handshake.
seed_data_creation: Registered a couple of throwaway users ga_test+<ts>@example.com / Test1234 for regression sign-in.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google full-flow can't be tested headlessly (needs real Google login at auth.emergentagent.com). Backend contract for POST /api/auth/session is covered by /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth_contract.py. Email+phone regression covered in the same file. On the frontend the Profile 'Sign out' button testID is 'logout-btn'. On web, tabs routes render at '/', so tab-navigation tests should check body content ('Discover'/'Continue with Google') rather than URL. Demo OTP is returned in JSON from POST /api/auth/phone/send-otp when in preview.
rca_of_issue: Profile sign-out UX: onPress={() => { logout(); router.replace('/welcome'); }} in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx line 95. logout() is async but not awaited; router.replace fires immediately. On expo-router web, when the Provider state flips user->null concurrently, root Index useEffect (which lives at '/') may reroute back to '/' rendering the tabs' default child (Discover) — leaving URL at '/' while user is null. Reload correctly hits Root Index gate -> /welcome. Fix by awaiting logout() first, or by adding an auth guard to (tabs)/_layout.tsx that navigates to /welcome when user becomes null.
